data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Hieros' meaning sacred and 'Hagos' meaning venerable or holy. Jeroma was a name given to a highly respected woman in ancient Greek society.

data.cultural_impact: Jeroma was a name that denoted reverence and respect in ancient Greek society. It was given to women who held high social status and were regarded as wise and venerable members of their communities. The name Jeroma continues to evoke a sense of honor and admiration, and is often used as a given name for girls who are believed to possess noble traits.
data.spiritual_significance: Jeroma represents the spiritual attributes of reverence, respect, and sanctity. It is a name that reminds us of the importance of honoring and respecting the sacred aspects of life, and of striving for wisdom and holiness in our own lives. The name Jeroma can serve as a reminder of the divine feminine and the sacred role that women have played in various cultures throughout history. It is a name that encourages us to look to the wisdom of our elders and to seek wisdom and guidance from those who hold sacred knowledge and understanding.
